body:
P0-05 context delivery d25efe89b94eae8767553615f166db222424b4a6 is reviewed but held for one narrow fail-closed repair; preserve it and append a normal follow-up commit in your existing branch. This is the existing callable segment, not a new task. Assigned scope baseline remains 7b36ccbaf86879f2a7518f39e419a345e136ade8.

Concrete independently reproduced bug: context.py _snapshot_fingerprint hashes mapping values only. After constructing valid FixtureArchive + RetrievalIndex with two synthetic owners and overlapping frame IDs, remap the frame dictionary keys between the owners while leaving values and insertion order unchanged:
archive.frames = {("other-user" if owner == USER else USER, frame_id): value for (owner, frame_id), value in archive.frames.items()}
The fingerprint remains equal; assemble_context(user_id=USER, actor="teacher") returns evidence.user_id=USER with evidence.frame.user_id="other-user". This is an in-process corrupted snapshot, not a demonstrated remote attack, but violates the assigned mutated-snapshot/source-frame isolation requirement.

Before accepting either archive fingerprint, verify every source/frame/event mapping key against each value's intrinsic identity (source_key; user_id/frame_id; user_id/event_id). Reject any mismatch before index.search or raw evidence access. Add key-only remapping regressions for all three maps and the separate index.archive path, preserving all originals, existing labels/ranking and tests. Do not create a new archive or change retrieval semantics.

Other review areas passed: 28 context cases, four exact examples, 327 additional Unicode/budget boundary probes, fresh-process/hash-seed stability and 187 unchanged originals. Reuse those results; run only tests relevant to this repair/necessary module regression. Deliver exact follow-up SHA and evidence of the formerly failing cross-owner-frame repro now rejecting. No provider, DB, shared-schema or dependency work needed. No acknowledgement-only reply; return the actual fix.

P0-03/P0-11 delivery ea39a3d0fcfd4dba02577df9cb228eddaf531e3d + e221793024501be68ba0586dcec2e3ce8a6449e5 is received and reviewed at the current safe boundary. Hold integration for a narrow retention wording correction, not a restart of your research. Preserve your commits and append a normal follow-up on the existing branch.

Concrete contradiction confirmed in e221793:
- docs/verification/platform/p0-11-g7-plan.md section 17, item 7 (around lines 849–855) forbids any extension/App Group media file except the ring buffer and says "The only local media" are transient buffers.
- p0-11-device-checklist.md AV06 (around 942–946) repeats the blanket media-file prohibition.
This conflicts with the same plan sections 3/4 and AUDIO-13/14: authorized durable source key images, editable original ink, observed attempts/transcripts/time relations and pre-stop queued artifacts must remain. A later cross-reference saying key images remain does not remove the explicit prohibition.

Narrow those restrictions to continuous/full-session AV recordings and declared transient AV buffers. Explicitly allow durable authorized source keyframes/original artifacts (including file-backed storage), original ink/transcripts/process evidence and pre-stop preservation; no saved lecture/replay prerequisite, automatic recording expansion or erase-on-stop. Buffer overflow must record gaps and not silently replace required durable source preservation. Do not promise permanently retaining every raw duplicate/audio sample merely because it was transiently observed. Keep normal explicit deletion separate. Synchronize plan/checklist and any current repeated clause, leave historical source quotations and all not_tested/not_run statuses intact.

No new official-source research, hardware/mode activation, purchase or Swift implementation requested. Both current capability checker profiles and self-tests were independently reproduced successfully; after this small correction rerun appropriate document/checker consistency only. Return follow-up SHA and exact corrected clauses once. Lead will integrate ea39a3d then e221793 then your fix, preserving both lead clarification and R60 header at the one known overlap; do not reset or rewrite the merge.

P0-09 implementation 75f4e3327527af5fefa7f0d9ed9808b428cd47b7 is reviewed and integrated as 76f206c. Tested milestone is now pushed and ls-remote verified at bc7162d3990b31c3418b437468c41013ee4038f1. Read docs/verification/lead/p0-09-capture-integration.md at a safe boundary; preserve your current work. Main check: 807 passed,16 expected failures plus generation/TS/Web build; independent portable reviewers ran 60 capture cases +3 probes and38 storage/runner checks. Your26 PostgreSQL groups remain accurately owner-executed, not independently rerun. Migration0002 bytes/checksum retained, including documented EOF blank line;0001 unchanged.

One next bounded continuation under existing P0-09: strengthen the real-PostgreSQL lifecycle race evidence. In postgres_capture_check.py around67–69 and97–100, the second-call event is signaled before the connection/actor-lock is entered; release then permits a merely serial execution. Current tests prove both ordered outcomes, not actual database contention. Instrument the dedicated runner to observe the competing PostgreSQL backend waiting on the intended first transaction before releasing it, using actual connection/backend IDs and bounded waits (no sleep-only inference). Cover capture-vs-stop and capture-vs-delete in both directions, timeout/failure cleanup, and keep every generated synthetic actor/child under existing cleanup. Assert final originals/replay fences as before. If runtime permissions prevent observing wait, report exact limitation instead of inventing proof.

Use the existing operator-provided isolated PostgreSQL/test DB; do not recreate/start/stop its service, change migration bytes, connect production, install deps or run a new v2 HTTP/provider. Update your evidence to distinguish the previous serial-order observation from new actual contention. Commit only your owned runner/tests/docs changes, deliver exactSHA+commands/results/failure evidence. No whole unchanged application suite required. Main also fixes QA-14 via a shared pre-schema depth guard; valid v0.1 payloads/wire artifacts unchanged. You may read/merge the exact baseline normally when safe, no reset/ff-only requirement. No acknowledgement-only loop.

Continue your already-started Learning index/source-protection QA first; no interruption or repeat of completed capture-schema review. At the next safe boundary, one substantive continuation under P0-13 is the now-pushed exact main bc7162d3990b31c3418b437468c41013ee4038f1. Your c49747b report/regressions were integrated as03b2579; Backend75f4e33 as76f206c. Read docs/verification/lead/p0-09-capture-integration.md.

QA-14 is now repaired in shared v1/v2 validators: iterative depth guard before encoding/jsonschema, dict/list/tuple/cycle handling, payload-free errors. Current schema depth<=6 vs limit64; no valid wire shape change. Both legacy validator byte pins explicitly record the sole safety delta and retain old digest; schemas/generators/examples remain frozen. Your three QA-14 strict xfails were promoted; low QA-P08-01/02 remain. Direct validator tests now build nested structures iteratively (older Python parsers can reject before validator); raw52k HTTP test retained. Independently verify the repaired validator/error-stringification and events/sources HTTP cases at the exact candidate, preserving all historical reports.

Also review bounded internal CaptureArchive auth/resolver/stop/delete-before-cache, exactACK/body replay, owned dependencies/frame/blob and shared-artifact deletion/rollback against released README. No production registration/HTTP/upload capability is released; test resolvers are synthetic. Backend real26-group report is owner evidence; actual lock-wait observation was missing and is now its own assigned runner correction. You may use portable independent checks now; do not count them as independent realDB/device/provider/G7 acceptance. No new provisioning, paid provider or unrelated Web rerun. Current main fullcheck807pass16xfail is lead evidence only.

Learning callable context d25efe8 is held for a separately reproduced key-only map remap returning another owner's frame. Do not fold it into accepted main QA; original owner is fixing under P0-05. Deliver concrete independent findings/commit once; no acknowledgment-only reply or duplicated task.
